messages:
maria: Heads-up — we’re seeing a tokenizer regression in eu-west1 canary when seqlen > 2048. Error rate ~2.3% on the canary shard, affects a minority of requests but causes client retries. Need an expedited patch and deploy tonight; propose pinning model artifacts to v2.3.0-compatible build and rolling a quick patch (v2.3.2).

deploy-bot: Canary started: release/expedite-tokenizer-fix@v2.3.2-canary -> 12 pods in eu-west1. Initial health: 10/12 passing, 2 failing (tokenize errors).

aj: Can someone paste a repro? I want to confirm it's the same failure mode we fixed in staging last week. Also what's our rollback plan if canary worsens?

maria: Repro (quick):
```
curl -X POST https://inference.eu-west1.redwood/api/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-tokenizer","input":"<really long input...>"}'
# returns 500 with `tokenize_internal_error`
```
This matches the stacktrace from staging. Fix is a small change to token boundary logic; I built v2.3.2-canary and pushed image.

carla: I'm +1 on expedited. This is causing production retries and cost. We need approvals from oncall + release lead to proceed. @sanjay can you take oncall signoff?

sanjay: Oncall triage: I see the alert. Impacted p99 request path for some customers, does not block core traffic but increases retries. I will hold traffic and watch the canary. Approve expedite if the canary shows <0.5% error over the next 10m and no latency regressions.

deploy-bot: Metrics update (10m): error_rate=0.8% (down from 2.3%), avg_latency=+0.9ms. 11/12 pods healthy.

leo: I’m +1 to proceed with staged rollout given metrics trend. Reminder: include explicit release-note callout for customers who pinned older artifact.

maria: Rolling to 50% now (patch rollout). Pin command used:
```
# update deployment image
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/tokenizer tokenizer=registry.redwood/release:v2.3.2-canary --record
```
Also applied temporary feature-flag `tokenizer_boundary_fallback=true` for graceful degradation.

ops-bot: Deploy approved by sanjay, leo, carla. Auto-rollback policy: rollback to registry.redwood/release:v2.3.0 if error_rate > 1.5% sustained for 15m or if SLOs breached.

maria: Noted. If green at 30m, we plan full rollout tonight at 23:30 UTC and then promote artifact to `release/v2.3.2`. I’ll prepare release notes and post to #announcements and customer-notifications for any pin guidance.

carla: Thanks team — watch window agreed. :eyes: :shipit:

aj: Thanks, will keep smoke tests running and post results in 10m.

deploy-bot: Canary window complete (30m): error_rate=0.3%, avg_latency=+0.6ms, no SLO breaches. Continuing to full rollout per plan.

maria: Full rollout started. Will update when promotion is done.

ops-bot: Promotion complete. release/v2.3.2 tagged and documented in release registry. Audit: approvers sanjay, leo, carla; deployer maria.

maria: Closing thread — release notes draft posted to /docs/release-notes/2024-08-11-tokenizer-fix.md and will schedule postmortem if further customer impact emerges.
